subject: Short-term capacity retainer & pre-authorized PO for launch week
messages:
From: Jay Patel <jay.patel@acme-retail.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acme-retail.com, Samantha Li <samantha.li@acme-retail.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short-term capacity retainer & pre-authorized PO for launch week

Jordan —

We're ramping up to a consumer-facing feature launch the week of May 10 and expect a heavy but short-lived traffic spike. We estimate roughly 200k additional token-equivalents over ~7 days (peak windows in PST afternoons).

Two asks: can Redwood provide (1) a short-term pre-authorized PO / retainer mechanism we can put on file to guarantee burst capacity, and (2) an amortization option so the cost can be spread across upcoming invoices rather than being invoiced as a one-off overrun?

Budget is limited; if a retainer lowers the overrun per-token rate that would help justify it. Attached is our launch plan (launch_plan_v2.pdf) with traffic profile.

Can you send a quick options sheet (retainer size, covered buffer, rate delta vs standard overrun)? Procurement needs a PDF/PO to approve.

Thanks,
Jay Patel
Head of Integrations, Acme Retail
jay.patel@acme-retail.com
+1 415-555-0123

--
Attachment: launch_plan_v2.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Jay Patel <jay.patel@acme-retail.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short-term capacity retainer & pre-authorized PO for launch week

Hi Jay —

Appreciate the heads-up and the launch plan — looks like a classic short-window spike. We have two pragmatic paths for this type of event:

Option A — Retainer buffer (recommended for predictable billing):
- One-time retainer fee: $12,000 (prepay)
- Buffer provided: 500k token-equivalents usable within a 14-day window
- Overrun rate if buffer exhausted: $0.0009 / token
- If buffer used <50%, residual credit applies to next invoice

Option B — No retainer, priced overrun:
- Immediate overrun rate: $0.0016 / token
- Standard invoicing after month-end

We can amortize the retainer across up to 3 invoices (default), or accelerate to 2 invoices if you need the cost out of the next close. If you provide a PO and sign the retainer addendum, we’ll also include a 30-day bridge credit on any disputed usage during launch.

I've attached a provisional rate sheet (provisional-rate-sheet.xlsx) and a sample fillable PO for procurement. If you confirm which option you'd like, I can route an addendum and DocuSign.

Next steps I suggest: you confirm desired buffer size and amortization cadence; I'll generate a PO-ready quote for your procurement team.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
Office: +1 650-555-0189

--
Attachment: provisional-rate-sheet.xlsx (xlsx, 34KB)

From: Jay Patel <jay.patel@acme-retail.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-retail.com, Samantha Li <samantha.li@acme-retail.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short-term capacity retainer & pre-authorized PO for launch week

Jordan —

Thanks, that helps. A few follow-ups from procurement and engineering:

1) Can you push the retainer to $10k if we commit to the PO today? We're comfortable with a 2-invoice amortization but need a better headline number to get internal sign-off.
2) For the first 100k tokens of burst usage, can you match $0.0006 / token? We expect the first day to consume the bulk of the spike.
3) Are there any SLA or priority routing commitments tied to this retainer, or is it purely billing/financial?

Procurement is ready to accept a fillable PO once we have the final numbers.

Also attaching the internal budget code (ACME-LAUNCH-22) they need on the PO.

Appreciate quick turnaround.

Jay

--
Attachment: ACME_Budget_Code.txt (text, 1KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 09:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short-term capacity retainer & pre-authorized PO for launch week

Jordan —

You have my OK to grant a one-time concession here. Approve the following:
- Retainer fee: $10,200 (15% discount applied to $12,000)
- Amortize across 2 invoices
- First 100k tokens at $0.0006 / token, remainder at $0.0009 / token while buffer remains; post-buffer overrun at $0.0016

Finance confirms revenue recognition acceptable for a prepaid retainer and the PO flow. Please include standard pre-authorized PO language and require DocuSign + PO upload to billing inbox to trigger amortization.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Jay Patel <jay.patel@acme-retail.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-retail.com, Samantha Li <samantha.li@acme-retail.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: short-term capacity retainer & pre-authorized PO for launch week

Jay —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the budget code. Good news: we can do the concession Ben approved. Revised terms below (final):

- One-time retainer: $10,200 (15% discount)
- Buffer: 500k token-equivalents usable within a 14-day window starting on activation
- Amortization: spread across 2 invoices after activation
- Burn pricing while buffer available: first 100k tokens at $0.0006 / token; next tokens from buffer at $0.0009 / token
- Post-buffer overrun rate: $0.0016 / token
- Requirement: signed DocuSign addendum + fillable PO (ACME-LAUNCH-22) uploaded to billing@redwood.com to enable amortization

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/acme-burst-2027
Fillable PO: ACME_PO_FILLABLE.pdf (attached)

If that works, I’ll send the DocuSign package now and route to billing once the PO is returned. Happy to hop on a 15-minute call if procurement/legal wants to walk through language.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cell: +1 650-555-0189
